cohort: 518 pregnant women over 18 years old who underwent the DIPSI test at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Gestational diabetes was found in 15.44% of participants and was associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, gestational hypertension, polyhydramnios, and vaginal candidiasis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the GDM group (72.1% vs. lower in the non-GDM group, p < 0.001).
